sets.description: Final data set: original rig runs generated with the island algorithm (exact repeats removed) plus later rig runs.
Original 23,915 rig runs; only patterns not already in the final set were added: an early batch of 2,514 patterns that were not generated with the island algorithm.

Earlier rig runs recovered from the lab experiment folders (Experiment*/data_filtered): GNN, clustering, synthesis and inverse-design test patterns, one run per pattern, each run zero-offset corrected and stopped at the 20 N force limit.
